user.title: Choose your lights
user.description: LumaFlow only adjusts these lights while they're on. It never turns a light on or off. Light groups work too: each light in the group is adjusted on its own.

timing.title: Timing and ranges
timing.description: From sunset (plus the offset) lights dim and warm over four hours to the night values, and they come back up over an hour after sunrise.

data_description.sunset_offset: Start winding down this many minutes before (negative) or after sunset.
data_description.transition_speed: How long each adjustment fades over: slow 5 min, moderate 3 min, fast 1 min.

data.enable_override_detection: Leave a light alone after it's changed by hand
data.restore_on_startup: Put lights back on the curve when Home Assistant starts

data_description.enable_override_detection: Until it's switched off and on again, restored with lumaflow.restore_lights, or midnight passes.

enable.name: Enable
enable.description: Turn circadian lighting on for every LumaFlow entry.

disable.name: Disable
disable.description: Stop adjusting lights. Settings are kept.

restore_lights.name: Restore lights
restore_lights.description: Clear manual overrides and put lights straight back on the curve.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Only these lights. Leave empty for all of them.

override_lights.name: Override lights
override_lights.description: Set lights to your own values; LumaFlow leaves them alone until they're restored, switched off and on, or midnight.

rgb_color.name: RGB colour
rgb_color.description: Red, green and blue, 0 to 255 each.
